paragraphs: The GLE300d has been part of the GLE-Class range since the model's renaming from M-Class in 2015, and across its two generations has used three different diesel engines - from the OM642 V6 through to today's OM656 inline-six. The full breakdown by engine code is below.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLE300D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLE300D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLE300d spans three distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement - or assuming an OM642 part will work on a V167 car - risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (OM642, OM654 or OM656) via registration or VIN - Your generation (W166 or V167) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
